description: This file contains unit tests for the 'ChannelsSettings' component, focusing on the visual and data representation of channel configurations in different states within the application. It includes setup functions, test cases, and mock data related to multiple messaging channels such as WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, and iMessage.

classes.name: ChannelsSettingsSmokeTests
classes.description: A suite of tests for the ChannelsSettings UI component, verifying its behavior when given different channel configuration data.

methods.name: makeChannelsStore
methods.description: A helper function to create a mock ChannelsStore populated with predefined channel data and a timestamp.
